artworks.title: Adélaide...Adélaide...il me semble que je vois deja venir la comète !!...
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features two figures in full body. On the left, a person leans forward, holding a candle in a holder. This person has an elongated face with high cheekbones and wears a nightcap and loose, simple clothing. On the right, a second person is slightly bent over, looking through a telescope. This figure's facial features include sharp, pronounced lines and a focused expression, with a tall, pointed hat on their head. They wear tight-fitting clothing and hold a telescope aimed toward an open window showing a night sky dotted with small stars. The background shows the framed, open window with a railing outside, in an interior space dimly illuminated by candlelight.

artworks.title: ça n'est rien Éléonore...ca n'est rien...
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals, a man and a woman, caught in a storm. The woman has distinct facial features and tied hair, wearing a long dress with a scarf. The man has exaggerated features, wild hair, and holds an umbrella. The woman's dress and the man's coat have bold lines indicating wind. The man is holding his hat in one hand. In the background, heavy rain is depicted, with faint outlines of buildings.

artworks.title: Fragment of the Old City Wall at San Giovanni Laterano
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper [proof state]
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 17 x 9.5 cm (6 11/16 x 3 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of an old structure with intricate details on its facade. Surrounding vegetation and aged walls suggest abandonment and passage of time. The sky is filled with swirling clouds. The technique includes cross-hatching and stippled brushstrokes for texture and shading. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing contrast. Figures, including a person on the ground and a woman with a child, add scale and liveliness to the scene.

artworks.title: The Pyramid of Sesto near the Gates of St. Pauli in Rome
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper [proof state]
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 17.3 x 9.7 cm (6 13/16 x 3 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a large conical structure covered in vegetation. The horizon is blocked by the structure, which features arched windows and vines. The sky has swirling clouds. The painting is done in a cross-hatched style, and there are two figures on a rocky outcrop. The color palette is mostly browns and sepia tones.

artworks.title: The Old Palace at Tivoli
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper [proof state]
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15.5 x 10.9 cm (6 1/8 x 4 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays an aerial view of a ruin with stone structures. The ruins overshadow the background, with remnants of arches in the far distance. The etching technique captures textures precisely, from the stone surfaces to the foliage. The color scheme is sepia or black and white. A waterfall with rocks and vegetation is in the foreground, along with two small figures and a seated person. In the distance, another figure is faintly visible through the arches.

artworks.title: The Outskirts of Florence, on the Way to Rome
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper [proof state]
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14.5 x 11.4 cm (5 11/16 x 4 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a rocky landscape with two figures, foliage, trees and a sky with clouds. The foreground features detailed rocks, bushes and trees. The sky has wispy clouds. The color palette consists of variations in ink tones conveying light and shadow.

artworks.title: The Road Crossing Mount Praco, from Ricci to Genoa
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper [proof state]
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14.7 x 11.8 cm (5 13/16 x 4 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a mountainous landscape with rocky terrain, trees, and figures. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, offering a broad view of the area. The horizon is obscured by rock formations and trees, with hills fading into the distance. The brushstrokes are detailed to create texture on rocks and foliage. Figures and animals are depicted with fluid lines, adding activity to the scene. The color palette is monochromatic, featuring browns and grays. Additional textured trees and clouds are visible in the background sky.

artworks.title: Harbor at Livorno
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper [proof state]
artworks.description: The image shows a tall tower on the left side near a rocky shore with a low horizon. The sky is filled with swirling clouds. The artwork features intricate linework and a monochrome color palette. Boats can be seen in the distance, with small human figures near the tower and shoreline.

artworks.title: Harbor at Livorno
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13.7 x 9.6 cm (5 3/8 x 3 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a rocky shoreline with a tall, weathered tower on the left side. A group of people are gathered at the tower's base. Near the water's edge, there are more people and boats. The horizon is low in the image, with water stretching towards it and faint outlines of distant structures. The sky is cloudy with cross-hatched patterns. The color palette is monochromatic, with black ink on a pale background creating contrast.

artworks.title: Mythological Figures
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown wash over red chalk, heightened with white, on laid paper; laid down
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of mythological figures intertwined with each other. The drawing depicts multiple figures representing mythological beings with detailed features and flowing lines. The central figure is wrapped in a serpentine form, creating a dynamic and intertwined composition. The artwork uses varying shades of brown, adding depth and texture to the image. The curvilinear forms and soft application of ink create a sense of fluidity and grace.

artworks.title: Seated Faun
artworks.medium: red and black chalk heightened with white chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Lois and Georges de Ménil, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts a male figure from the knees upward, seated in a reclined position with his body turned slightly to the side. His left arm is raised to touch his shoulder while his right arm rests on his knee, and his head is tilted upwards, drawing attention to his facial features including a pronounced jawline and full lips. His hair is wavy and appears to be swept back. The figure is nude, emphasizing the contours of his muscular physique. A drapery or piece of cloth is suggested around his waist and extends to the ground, adding texture to the drawing. The background features loosely sketched elements, possibly suggesting foliage or clouds.

artworks.title: The Carrying of the Cross
artworks.medium: pen and gray-brown ink with gray-brown wash over black chalk on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Rudolf J. Heinemann and an Anonymous Donor
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures carrying a large object under an archway. The scene is rendered in monochrome ink with energetic lines conveying movement and struggle. The dominant element is a large, cross-like structure being carried by several figures. The setting features architectural elements including archways and a statue or artwork on the right-hand side. The use of shading creates depth and emphasizes the physicality of the scene.

artworks.title: Head of a Man
artworks.artist: Gilles Demarteau, the Elder after Edme Bouchardon
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in red on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ivan E. and Jacqueline Phillips
artworks.description: The image shows a man looking slightly upward, with wide eyes and a slightly open mouth. He has long, wavy hair, a full beard, and a mustache. He appears to be wearing a simple garment with a button or fastener at the top. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Fall of the Rebel Angels [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on thin laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows sinuous figures among clouds. The drawing features interwoven, muscular figures with an angelic or divine quality, set against a backdrop of flowing clouds. The artwork uses a monochrome palette to highlight the fluidity of the clouds and the contorted poses of the figures, creating a sense of movement and weightlessness. In the upper half of the composition, another figure appears with a radiant presence and light emanating from behind it, suggesting dominance or divinity. The artwork's delicate linework forms curls and swirls, conveying motion and energy throughout the composition.

artworks.title: Jael and Cisera? [verso]
artworks.medium: red chalk on thin laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two overlapping figures with dynamic outlines. The image features swirling lines and forms sketched in red chalk. A central figure with noticeable musculature appears to be interacting with a partially reclined form. The space is filled with loose, gestural lines suggesting fluid motion and chaotic energy. There is no clear background, giving the drawing a sense of study or exploration of form and movement. The emphasis is on the energy conveyed through dynamic poses and expressive line work.

artworks.title: Dodo and an Older Woman Reclining before a Mirror
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on heavy gray-green paper
artworks.description: This image is a minimalist, linear illustration featuring three nude female figures. The woman to the right is in a semi-reclined position, leaning on her left arm. Her face shows closed eyes and neutral lips, with short styled hair. The middle woman is also reclined, with bent legs and her face turned towards the viewer. The third woman on the left appears seated or lying on her side, facing towards the center. All the figures have simple facial features and hair, suggesting relaxed postures. There are no clothes, jewelry, or objects depicted, and the background is a blank, pale gray or off-white.

artworks.title: Head of a Woman
artworks.medium: colored chalks on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Peter Josten in memory of Stephen Spector and in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image is a portrait drawing of a person's profile from the top of the head to just below the chin. The individual is facing left, with softly rendered facial features including the nose, lips, and chin. The hair is short or closely cropped. The drawing emphasizes the natural lines and shading of the face and neck. There are no visible clothing details, objects, or jewelry. The background is simple with a textured look, focusing attention on the person's profile.

artworks.title: Angels and Putti
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash over charcoal; laid down
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 19.2 x 13.5 cm (7 9/16 x 5 5/16 in.)
support: 22 x 17.3 cm (8 11/16 x 6 13/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Malcolm Bick in honor of Dr. Ruth Benedict
artworks.description: This is a drawing of winged figures ascending into the sky. The drawing features multiple angelic figures sketched with fluid lines and pale washes of ink. The figures have outstretched wings and appear to be in motion. They are surrounded by flowing drapery and clouds, creating an ethereal and heavenly theme. Light and shadow are used to highlight the contours of the figures, adding dimension and depth. The style suggests inspiration from classical and baroque art traditions.

artworks.title: Caresses
artworks.medium: lithograph in red on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of two figures. One figure is standing and leaning forward with arms extended downward towards the other figure lying on the ground. The standing figure has a simple hairstyle and is wearing a long, flowing garment. The figure on the ground appears relaxed with limbs loosely positioned and their face slightly turned to the side. The background is plain with minimal details.

artworks.title: Mother and Children
artworks.medium: lithograph in red on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated on the right side, leaning forward with one hand on the ground. She wears a long-sleeved garment and has her hair in a bun. On the left side, there is a baby lying on their stomach, with one arm reaching forward. The background is plain with minimal details. The drawing appears to be done in a light and airy style, with sketchy lines.

artworks.title: Madchen (Girl)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a person from the chest up. The person is facing forward, slightly turned to the left, with eyes looking towards the viewer. The facial features are delicately drawn, accentuating bold eyebrows and a small, slightly open mouth. The hair is styled with a slight wave, appearing short. The person is wearing a collared garment that resembles a coat. Their right hand rests on their thigh in a relaxed pose. There are no visible jewelry pieces or other objects being held. The background consists of abstract, sharp, jagged lines framing the person.

artworks.title: The Fall into Infinity
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.description: This image displays the upper half of a figure positioned diagonally. The head is tilted downwards with abstract facial features including a prominent brow, deep-set eyes, and a furrowed expression. The dark hair flows backwards dynamically. An arm is outstretched upwards with slightly curled fingers. The surroundings are minimal with sketch-like lines indicating motion or energy, along with a faint outlined circle around the hand. The background is lightly colored and lacks detail, emphasizing the emotive gesture of the central figure.

artworks.title: The Great Anxiety (Self-Portrait, in Three-Quarter Profile to the Right) (Die große  Angst [Selbstportrat, Kopf im Halbprofil nach rechts])
artworks.medium: drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: This print is an abstract, close-up sketch of a person's upper body, focusing primarily on their face and hands. The person's face has exaggerated features, including large eyes and a sharp nose. Their hair is depicted in swirling strokes that extend outward. The person's hand is raised, showing long, thin fingers. The portrait is rendered in dynamic, sweeping black lines. The background is plain, off-white paper.

artworks.title: The Burial (Begrabnis)
artworks.medium: linocut in black on thin japan paper
artworks.description: The image is a black and white print depicting a wide, winding road leading towards a group of small, abstracted buildings on the horizon. The horizon line is high in the composition, and the buildings appear as simplified forms. Figures are seen walking down the road, portrayed in dark silhouettes, creating a sense of movement towards the distance. The technique seems to be a stark, bold graphic style, likely a woodcut or linocut print, featuring defined lines and shapes. The color palette is monochrome, using only black and white with high contrast and strong compositional elements.
